note: v0.9.0 package-proof artifacts are published on GitHub with SHA-256 sidecars and manifests. macOS is ad-hoc signed but not Developer ID signed or notarized, Windows is unsigned, and Linux is checksum-verified. These are not public-trust installers.

sourceStatus.autobee: 2.12.1 development compatibility test only; no user-data migration
sourceStatus.note: v0.9.1 Pear 3.4 and Autobee work is an unmerged draft candidate. The draft distinct-host fix passed a local macOS Electron cookie probe; real P2P app cookie-isolation capture in the packaged app, clean-install validation, and public-trust signing remain release blockers. The latest published desktop download is v0.9.0.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.openNote: Not Developer ID signed or notarized. Verify SHA-256 first, then right-click the app -> Open -> Open to get past Gatekeeper the first time (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on the .app).

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.openNote: The MSIX is unsigned, so Windows rejects a normal double-click install. Verify SHA-256 and download it only if you understand sideloading (Developer Mode + Add-AppxPackage). The former Pear identifier is not an alternative launch path.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.openNote: After downloading: chmod +x the file and run it. The AppImage bundles the GTK4/libadwaita runtime pieces needed by the native shell on standard desktop distributions.

p2p.note: Legacy migration record only. It is not a Pear v3 launch or install path. The linked website Hyperdrive is an earlier published edition; its current bytes have not been verified against this HTTPS candidate.

android.note: Mobile PR #6 is an unmerged draft on hold. An unsigned Android emulator build reached Connected and opened HTTPS and local Search. The Android emulator retained tab A through an A→B→A switch and cleared tabs when Private Mode was enabled, with no restore after restart. Prior-opt-in suppression is unverified. Android signing, Play validation, physical-device smoke, and P2P app origin isolation remain open; no signed APK or store listing is published.

ios.note: Mobile PR #6 is an unmerged draft on hold. Unsigned React Native and SwiftUI iOS simulator shells reached Connected. Apple team signing, TestFlight/App Store validation, physical-device smoke, and P2P app origin isolation remain open; no iOS store build is published.

knownLimitations.p2pAppCookies: In published v0.9.0, P2P drives use separate ports on 127.0.0.1, but Electron cookies are shared by host. A P2P page cookie can be visible to another drive; avoid putting secrets in P2P page cookies.
knownLimitations.publicTrustSigning: macOS Developer ID notarization and Windows signing are not complete.
